addition.title: Addition & subtraction
addition.summary: From carrying and borrowing to column addition and subtraction.

within-10.title: Adding & subtracting within 10
within-10.summary: Learn addition and subtraction within numbers up to 10.
within-10.description: Students practice addition and subtraction within the range of numbers up to 10, based on composing and decomposing numbers. These basic skills are essential for everyday tasks and form the foundation for future arithmetic. Being able to accurately count numbers from 1 to 10 will help you learn smoothly.

carry.title: Carrying & borrowing
carry.summary: Learn addition with carrying and subtraction with borrowing.
carry.description: Using groups of ten, learners practice addition with carrying and subtracting a single digit from teens with borrowing. This concept deepens understanding of place value and prepares students for larger calculations. A solid grasp of calculations within 10 makes this topic easier to master.

two-digit.title: Two-digit numbers
two-digit.description: Students learn to add and subtract two-digit numbers by aligning tens and ones places. These calculation skills are widely used in daily situations, such as finding total prices or change. Being confident with single-digit addition and subtraction involving regrouping will help you master this unit quickly.

column.title: Column addition & subtraction
column.summary: Learn column addition and subtraction for 3 to 4 digits.
column.description: Students learn how to use column methods to accurately add and subtract larger three- and four-digit numbers. This approach is practical when dealing with large quantities or monetary amounts. A firm foundation in two-digit addition, subtraction, and place-value principles will ensure smooth learning.

multiplication.title: Multiplication
multiplication.summary: From times tables to multiplying two- and three-digit numbers.

times-table.title: Times tables
times-table.summary: Master the multiplication tables from 1 to 9.
times-table.description: Students learn the multiplication tables from 1 to 9 based on repeated addition. These essential math facts are used constantly in everyday life, such as finding total items or calculating costs. A confident understanding of basic single-digit addition will help deepen your comprehension of multiplication.

by-one-digit.title: 2–3 digits × 1 digit
by-one-digit.summary: Learn to multiply 2- or 3-digit numbers by 1 digit.
by-one-digit.description: Students practice column multiplication by applying multiplication tables to each place value and handling carries when multiplying multi-digit numbers by a single digit. This skill helps calculate total costs for multiple identical items. Fluency in multiplication tables and column addition makes learning this process straightforward.

by-two-digit.title: 2–3 digits × 2 digits
by-two-digit.summary: Learn to multiply 2- or 3-digit numbers by 2 digits.
by-two-digit.description: Students learn column multiplication by splitting two-digit multipliers into tens and ones, then adding the partial products together. This method is frequently used for calculating large quantities, areas, or bulk purchases. Mastering basic multiplication tables and one-digit column multiplication ensures success in learning this procedure.

division.title: Division
division.summary: From division with times tables to remainders and dividing by two-digit numbers.

basic.title: Division with times tables
basic.summary: Learn basic division using multiplication tables.
basic.description: Students learn fundamental division concepts, such as equal sharing and grouping, by working backwards from multiplication tables. This skill is commonly used when distributing items equally among friends or groups. Solid mastery of multiplication tables is an essential prerequisite that allows learners to solve these problems smoothly.

remainder.title: Division with remainders
remainder.description: Students learn how to calculate quotients and remainders when numbers do not divide evenly, recognizing that remainders must be smaller than divisors. This applies to everyday situations like packing items into equal bags. Prior knowledge of basic division using multiplication tables and simple subtraction is helpful.

by-two-digit.title: Dividing by two-digit numbers
by-two-digit.summary: Learn long division by two-digit divisors.
by-two-digit.description: Students learn how to perform long division with two-digit divisors, including techniques for estimating and adjusting quotient digits. This method is valuable for distributing resources among large groups or converting units. Strong skills in one-digit long division, column multiplication, and subtraction are essential prerequisites for success.

arith.title: Order of operations & word problems
arith.summary: Order of operations, calculation rules and word problems.

order-of-operations.title: Order of operations
order-of-operations.description: Students learn the rules for order of operations: calculate inside parentheses first, and perform multiplication and division before addition and subtraction. Operations with the same priority are solved from left to right. This essential knowledge ensures accuracy when evaluating complex expressions with mixed operations.
order-of-operations.summary: Learn the proper order of operations with parentheses.

rules.title: Calculation rules
rules.description: Use the associative and distributive laws to calculate smartly.
rules.summary: Learn calculation rules to compute efficiently.

simple-word-problems.title: Simple word problems
simple-word-problems.description: Short word problems you can solve in one or two steps.

word-problems.title: Multi-step word problems
word-problems.description: Word problems that take two or three calculations. Try these after the easy ones.

unknowns.title: Boxes & letters in expressions
unknowns.summary: Writing and finding unknown numbers with boxes and letters.

box.title: Equations with a box
box.summary: Learn to set up and solve equations using shapes.
box.description: Students learn to express mathematical situations into equations using a box symbol for unknown numbers and solve them using inverse operations. This approach is helpful for finding missing quantities or differences in costs. A clear understanding of basic four arithmetic operations is essential before beginning.

letters.title: Expressions with letters
letters.summary: Learn to use letters to express mathematical formulas.
letters.description: Students learn to represent unknown quantities and mathematical relationships generally using letters like x, and evaluate them by substituting numbers. This serves as the foundation for algebra and scientific formulas. Familiarity with equations using shapes and basic arithmetic operations will help you succeed here.

place-value.title: Place value & large numbers
place-value.summary: Place value, from tens and hundreds up to millions and billions.

to-100.title: Numbers to 100
to-100.summary: Learn counting and place value up to 100.
to-100.description: Students learn how to read, write, and compare numbers up to 100 by focusing on groups of ten and place value. These skills are helpful for counting money, scores, or calendar dates. Being comfortable counting and recognizing numbers up to 20 provides a solid foundation for this topic.

to-10000.title: Numbers to 10,000
to-10000.summary: Learn reading and writing numbers up to 10,000.
to-10000.description: Students learn how to read, write, compose, and compare numbers up to 10,000 based on hundreds and thousands. This knowledge is used daily when handling paper money or measuring long distances. A strong grasp of numbers up to 100 and grouping by hundreds makes this topic easy to understand.

ten-thousands.title: Numbers in the ten thousands
ten-thousands.summary: Learn place value and numbers in the ten-thousands.
ten-thousands.description: Students learn how to read, write, and understand numbers in the ten-thousands place, using ten thousand as a new unit. These numbers are commonly used for describing city populations or prices of electronics. Familiarity with numbers up to 10,000 and the decimal place-value system provides the necessary background.

large-numbers.title: Large numbers
large-numbers.summary: Learn reading and writing large numbers up to trillions.
large-numbers.description: Students learn to read, write, and comprehend very large numbers such as ten-thousands, hundred-millions, and trillions by grouping digits into units of four or three. These values appear in national budgets, astronomical distances, and economics. Solid competence in place value up to ten-thousands will help you understand these massive numbers.

time.title: Clocks & time
time.summary: Reading clocks and working out elapsed time.

reading.title: Reading clocks
reading.summary: Learn how to read hours and minutes from an analog clock.
reading.description: In this topic, you will learn how to read hours and minutes using clock hands. This skill is helpful for managing daily routines and scheduling activities on time. Familiarity with counting numbers and recognizing basic numerals will support your learning.

elapsed.title: Elapsed time
elapsed.summary: Learn to calculate elapsed time and future or past times.
elapsed.description: You will learn how to determine elapsed time between two events and calculate future or past times. This is essential for planning daily schedules and estimating travel duration. A solid understanding of reading clocks and the relation that sixty minutes make an hour is helpful.

decimal.title: Decimals
decimal.summary: Practice adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing decimals.

add-sub-tenths.title: Adding & subtracting tenths
add-sub-tenths.summary: Learn addition and subtraction with tenths using decimals.
add-sub-tenths.description: You will learn how to add and subtract decimals with tenths by aligning the decimal points vertically. This technique is useful for combining and comparing fractional measurements of length or liquid volume. Prior mastery of multi-digit whole number addition and subtraction will make this easier.

add-sub.title: Adding & subtracting hundredths
add-sub.summary: Add and subtract decimals up to hundredths.
add-sub.description: You will learn how to add and subtract decimals up to hundredths, including numbers with different numbers of decimal digits, using column addition and subtraction. This method helps when working with precise measurements of length and weight. Familiarity with decimal place values and tenths will support your learning.

mul-div-whole.title: Decimals × and ÷ whole numbers
mul-div-whole.summary: Learn to multiply and divide decimals by whole numbers.
mul-div-whole.description: You will learn how to multiply and divide decimals by whole numbers using standard algorithms. This calculation is practical when finding the total weight of multiple identical items or sharing quantities equally. Being comfortable with whole number multiplication and division is essential for this topic.

mul-div.title: Decimals × and ÷ decimals
mul-div.summary: Learn to multiply and divide decimals by decimals.
mul-div.description: You will learn how to carry out multiplication and division where both numbers are decimals. This operation is widely used in calculating areas, unit rates, and scaling values proportionally. Familiarity with multiplying and dividing decimals by whole numbers provides a strong foundation for this topic.

fraction.title: Fractions
fraction.summary: Practice simplifying fractions, finding common denominators, and calculating with fractions.

unit-fractions.title: Halves & quarters
unit-fractions.summary: Learn basic fractions like halves and fourths of a whole.
unit-fractions.description: You will explore the basic meaning of fractions by dividing an entire object into equal parts such as halves and fourths. This concept helps when folding paper or sharing snacks equally among friends. Understanding how to divide quantities into equal groups is great preparation.

meaning.title: The size of fractions
meaning.summary: Understand fraction magnitude and representation on a line.
meaning.description: You will learn the meaning of numerators and denominators, interpreting fractions as collections of unit fractions on a number line. This knowledge is useful for reading scale markings and comparing fractional quantities. A basic grasp of dividing whole objects equally will support this topic.

simplify.title: Simplifying & common denominators
simplify.summary: Learn how to simplify and find common denominators.
simplify.description: You will learn how to simplify fractions and find common denominators by using equivalent fraction properties. These techniques are crucial for comparing fractions and preparing for addition and subtraction. Prior mastery of finding common factors and multiples will make these procedures straightforward.

fraction-decimal.title: Fractions, decimals & whole numbers
fraction-decimal.summary: Learn relations and conversions among fractions and decimals.
fraction-decimal.description: You will explore how to convert fractions into decimals and whole numbers, as well as rewrite decimals as fractions. This skill is valuable for comparing quantities given in different formats and simplifying complex calculations. A solid grasp of division and decimal place values is recommended.

add-sub-like.title: Adding & subtracting like fractions
add-sub-like.summary: Add and subtract fractions with same denominators.
add-sub-like.description: You will learn how to add and subtract fractions sharing identical denominators by operating only on their numerators. This is practical when combining or removing parts measured with the same unit fraction. Understanding that fractions represent collections of unit parts will make this concept very intuitive.

mixed.title: Mixed numbers & improper fractions
mixed.summary: Learn mixed numbers, improper fractions, and conversions.
mixed.description: You will learn the concepts of improper fractions and mixed numbers representing quantities of one or more, including how to convert between them. This helps when describing quantities greater than one in cooking or measurements. A firm understanding of proper fractions and integer division will make conversions much easier.

add-sub.title: Adding & subtracting unlike fractions
add-sub.summary: Add and subtract fractions with different denominators.
add-sub.description: You will learn how to add and subtract fractions with different denominators by finding a common denominator first. This skill is useful for combining quantities measured in the same unit but expressed with different denominators. Proficiency in finding least common multiples and simplifying fractions will ensure your success.

mul-div.title: Multiplying & dividing fractions
mul-div.summary: Learn multiplication and division of fractions.
mul-div.description: You will learn how to multiply fractions directly and divide fractions using reciprocals. You will also learn how to calculate efficiently by simplifying during calculations. These operations are commonly used when finding quantities from proportions, so mastering simplification steps is essential.

divisors.title: Factors & multiples
divisors.summary: Use factors and multiples to find common factors and common multiples.

divisors.title: Factors & multiples
divisors.summary: Learn the properties of factors and multiples of integers.
divisors.description: You will learn about factors as positive integers that divide an integer evenly, and multiples formed by multiplying an integer by 1, 2, 3, and so on. This helps with dividing objects equally without remainders and analyzing periodic patterns. Strong familiarity with basic multiplication and division provides a solid foundation.

gcd-lcm.title: Greatest common factor & least common multiple
gcd-lcm.summary: Find greatest common factors and least common multiples.
gcd-lcm.description: You will learn methods to determine the greatest common factor and least common multiple of two or more numbers. These concepts are essential for simplifying fractions, finding common denominators, and solving scheduling problems. A solid grasp of listing individual factors and multiples is recommended.

rounding.title: Rounding & estimation
rounding.summary: Round numbers up, down and to the nearest place to estimate results.

rounding.title: Rounding
rounding.summary: Learn how to round numbers using standard rules.
rounding.description: You will learn how to round numbers to a designated place value by rounding down or up depending on the digit. This method is practical for simplifying large numbers when reporting statistics, prices, or populations. Understanding place value systems and comparing single-digit numbers will help you master this skill.

estimate.title: Estimation
estimate.summary: Learn estimation techniques using rounded numbers.
estimate.description: You will learn how to estimate calculation results by rounding numbers before performing arithmetic operations. This technique is valuable for quick budget checks while shopping and for catching major computational errors during problem solving. Prior familiarity with rounding rules and basic four operations will make estimating much easier.

ratio.title: Percentages & ratios
ratio.summary: Learn the basics of percentages and ratios, then try word problems.

simple-ratio.title: Simple ratios: how many times
simple-ratio.summary: Understand how to compare quantities as simple multiples.
simple-ratio.description: You will learn how to express the relationship between two quantities by finding how many times greater one is than the base amount. This concept is useful when comparing lengths, weights, or prices in everyday situations. Prior understanding of multiplication and division concepts is essential for mastering this comparison.

percent.title: Percentages
percent.summary: Understand percentages based on a base value of 100.
percent.description: You will learn the meaning of percentages as ratios regarding the base quantity as 100, along with the percent symbol. This concept is commonly used when calculating discounts, growth rates, and statistical data. A clear grasp of decimal operations and basic ratios provides a strong foundation.

ratio.title: Simplifying ratios
ratio.summary: Learn how to simplify ratios to the lowest terms.
ratio.description: Learn how to simplify ratios into their simplest integer form using the properties of equivalent ratios. This skill is useful for comparing quantities clearly, such as in cooking recipes and scale drawings. Having prior knowledge of common factors and simplifying fractions will help solve problems smoothly.

word-problems.title: Percentage word problems
word-problems.summary: Learn to solve word problems using proportions and ratios.
word-problems.description: Learn how to identify base and compared quantities from word problems to find ratios correctly. This method is widely used in daily situations such as calculating discounts and analyzing statistical data. Prior mastery of decimal multiplication and division will make solving these problems much smoother.

measurement.title: Measurement
measurement.summary: Practice converting units and finding areas and volumes.

length-capacity.title: Length & capacity
length-capacity.summary: Learn units and measurement for length and capacity.
length-capacity.description: Learn standard units and measurement methods for length and capacity, such as meters and liters. These skills are helpful for measuring objects and comparing liquid amounts in daily life. Having basic knowledge of numbers along with simple addition and subtraction will make learning these units much easier.

weight.title: Weight
weight.summary: Learn units of weight and how to measure weight.
weight.description: Learn units of weight such as grams and kilograms, and how to read scales correctly. These measurement skills are essential when weighing cooking ingredients or checking luggage in daily life. Prior understanding of basic measurement units and multi-digit addition and subtraction will make calculations easy and intuitive.

area-units.title: Units of area
area-units.summary: Learn various units of area and how to convert them.
area-units.description: Learn various area units, from square centimeters and square meters to ares and hectares. These units are necessary for describing the size of rooms, gardens, and larger land areas. Prior understanding of length unit conversions and mastery of large number multiplication will provide a solid foundation.

rect-area.title: Area of rectangles & squares
rect-area.summary: Learn formulas to calculate rectangle and square areas.
rect-area.description: Learn the formulas to calculate the areas of rectangles and squares by multiplying their side lengths. This method is practical for measuring floor space or paper sizes in daily activities. Having a solid proficiency in multiplication and understanding the properties of rectangles and squares will make calculations easy.

area.title: Area of triangles, parallelograms & trapezoids
area.summary: Learn area formulas for triangles and parallelograms.
area.description: Learn the geometric formulas to calculate the areas of triangles, parallelograms, and trapezoids using base and height. These formulas are useful in carpentry, land measurement, and design projects. Prior knowledge of rectangle area calculation along with perpendicular and parallel lines will help in understanding the derivations.

volume.title: Volume of cuboids & cubes
volume.summary: Learn formulas to calculate rectangular prism volumes.
volume.description: Learn the formulas to calculate the volume of rectangular prisms and cubes from their dimensions, along with units of volume. This knowledge is used to determine box capacities and liquid storage sizes. Prior familiarity with rectangle area and mastery of multiplying three numbers will make calculations straightforward.

circumference.title: Circumference
circumference.summary: Learn the concept of pi and how to find circumference.
circumference.description: Learn the meaning of pi and the formula to calculate the circumference of a circle from its diameter. This calculation is used when determining tire distances or measuring circular columns. Prior understanding of the relationship between radius and diameter, along with mastery of decimal multiplication, will ensure smooth calculations.

circle-area.title: Area of circles
circle-area.summary: Learn the formula and reasoning for the area of a circle.
circle-area.description: Learn how to find the area of a circle by rearranging finely divided sectors into a shape close to a rectangle. This method applies to measuring circular flower beds, table surfaces, and pizza sizes. Prior understanding of pi and the area formula of parallelograms will make learning this concept smooth and intuitive.

prism-volume.title: Volume of prisms & cylinders
prism-volume.summary: Learn to calculate volumes of prisms and cylinders.
prism-volume.description: Learn how to calculate the volumes of prisms and cylinders by multiplying base area by height. This technique is applied when determining container capacities, storage tanks, and architectural columns. Prior mastery of calculating base areas, such as triangles and circles, along with rectangular prism volumes will ensure solid comprehension.

shapes.title: Basic shapes
shapes.summary: Triangles, quadrilaterals, circles and measuring angles.

solids-basic.title: Solid shapes
solids-basic.summary: Learn the basic shapes and features of everyday solids.
solids-basic.description: Learn to identify common three-dimensional shapes like boxes, cylinders, and spheres by observing their surfaces and rolling abilities. These observational skills help with organizing objects and building structures in daily play. Experiencing hands-on exploration and comparing real-world items will provide an excellent and intuitive starting point for this learning.

basic-shapes.title: Rectangles, squares & right triangles
basic-shapes.summary: Learn features of rectangles, squares, and right triangles.
basic-shapes.description: Learn the properties of rectangles, squares, and right triangles by focusing on side lengths and right angles. These concepts are useful for recognizing shapes in everyday objects like paper, screens, and tiles. Prior familiarity with straight lines, vertices, and measuring lengths using a ruler will support smooth and confident learning.

boxes.title: Box shapes: faces, edges & vertices
boxes.summary: Learn the faces, edges, and vertices of box shapes.
boxes.description: Learn about the components of boxes by examining the shapes and numbers of their faces, edges, and vertices. This knowledge helps when assembling paper crafts, packaging boxes, and visualizing unfolded nets. Prior understanding of rectangles, squares, and right angles will make it easier to grasp these three-dimensional spatial structures.

triangles.title: Isosceles & equilateral triangles
triangles.summary: Learn isosceles and equilateral triangle properties.
triangles.description: Learn the properties of isosceles and equilateral triangles regarding their side lengths, angles, and compass construction. These geometric features are widely utilized in architectural trusses and structural design. Having prior knowledge of basic triangle definitions and length measurement will help you understand and draw these figures with ease.

quadrilaterals.title: Parallelograms, trapezoids & rhombuses
quadrilaterals.summary: Learn features of parallelograms, trapezoids, rhombuses.
quadrilaterals.description: Learn the geometric properties of trapezoids, parallelograms, and rhombuses by examining parallel sides, side lengths, and diagonals. These quadrilaterals are used in creating tessellation patterns and analyzing mechanical linkages. Prior understanding of parallel and perpendicular lines, as well as angle measurement, will make classifying and constructing them straightforward.

circles.title: Circles & spheres
circles.summary: Learn properties of centers, radii, and diameters.
circles.description: Learn the geometric properties of circles and spheres by focusing on centers, radii, and diameters. These round shapes are essential in understanding wheels, clock faces, sports balls, and compass drawings. Prior familiarity with length measurement and basic solid shapes will provide the necessary foundation for understanding this topic.

compass-drawing.title: Drawing with a compass
compass-drawing.summary: Learn how to draw circles and copy lengths using a compass.
compass-drawing.description: Learn how to use a compass to draw circles and accurately transfer line segment lengths. These techniques are useful for creating geometric patterns and constructing triangles with specified side lengths. Prior understanding of ruler usage and the meaning of a circle's radius will help you practice effectively.

angles.title: Measuring angles
angles.summary: Learn units of degrees and how to measure angles.
angles.description: Learn the unit of degrees and how to measure and construct various angles using a protractor. Understanding angles is useful in navigation, astronomy, and observing slopes or hands on a clock. Prior familiarity with right angles, vertices, and straight lines will help you read protractor scales accurately and comfortably.

perpendicular-parallel.title: Perpendicular & parallel lines
perpendicular-parallel.summary: Learn perpendicular and parallel lines and how to draw them.
perpendicular-parallel.description: Learn the properties and construction of perpendicular lines intersecting at right angles and parallel lines that never meet on the same plane. These concepts help describe positional relationships in intersections and railroad tracks. Prior knowledge of right angles and triangle rulers ensures neat, accurate line construction.

parallel-drawing.title: Drawing parallel & perpendicular lines
parallel-drawing.summary: Draw parallel and perpendicular lines using set squares.
parallel-drawing.description: Learn how to accurately draw parallel and perpendicular lines using set squares and rulers. Precise drawing forms the foundation for understanding geometric properties of quadrilaterals. Being familiar with the basic concepts of right angles and parallelism will help you succeed.

cuboids.title: Cuboids & cubes: nets & sketches
cuboids.summary: Learn properties, sketches, and nets of cuboids and cubes.
cuboids.description: Explore the properties of cuboids and cubes, focusing on their faces, edges, and vertices. Drawing sketches and nets helps develop spatial visualization skills for three-dimensional shapes. Reviewing the basic properties of rectangles, squares, and right angles beforehand will make learning more effective.

congruent.title: Congruent figures
congruent.summary: Learn the properties and features of congruent figures.
congruent.description: Investigate properties of congruent figures that match exactly when overlapped, including corresponding sides, angles, and vertices. Learning to identify figures with identical shape and size provides essential groundwork for geometric reasoning and construction. Reviewing how to measure lengths and angles is recommended.

congruent-drawing.title: Drawing congruent figures
congruent-drawing.summary: Draw congruent triangles using a protractor and compass.
congruent-drawing.description: Learn how to construct congruent triangles using a compass, ruler, and protractor based on specific side lengths and angle measurements. Focusing on necessary geometric conditions prepares you for technical drawing and design. Familiarity with the basic properties of congruent figures will make this topic easier to master.

angle-sum.title: Angle sums of triangles & quadrilaterals
angle-sum.summary: Find the angle sums of triangles and quadrilaterals.
angle-sum.description: Learn that the interior angles of a triangle add up to 180 degrees, while those of a quadrilateral sum to 360 degrees. This fundamental property is essential for calculating unknown angles across various geometric figures. Reviewing angle measurement and the concept of straight angles will deepen your understanding.

prisms.title: Prisms & cylinders
prisms.summary: Explore the properties and nets of prisms and cylinders.
prisms.description: Explore the structures and properties of prisms and cylinders, examining relationships between bases and lateral surfaces alongside their nets. Understanding these solid shapes is crucial for calculating surface area and volume in real-world contexts. Reviewing cuboids, rectangles, and circle properties beforehand will help you understand the concepts smoothly.

symmetry.title: Symmetry & scale drawings
symmetry.summary: Line and point symmetry, and enlargements and reductions.

symmetry.title: Line & point symmetry
symmetry.summary: Learn line symmetry and point symmetry in geometric shapes.
symmetry.description: Study line symmetry, where figures fold onto themselves, and rotational point symmetry around a center. These concepts are widely used to analyze patterns in nature, art, and architecture. Having a clear grasp of congruent shapes and basic angle measurements will make constructing symmetric figures much easier.

scale.title: Scale drawings
scale.summary: Understand scale drawings and scaled figures using ratios.
scale.description: Learn how figures change in size while maintaining the same shape, examining corresponding side lengths and invariant angles. Scaled drawings are essential for interpreting maps, blueprints, and architectural models in everyday life. Reviewing ratios, proportions, and the properties of congruent figures will help you grasp this topic effectively.

data.title: Working with data
data.summary: Explore data by finding the mean, median, and range.

average.title: Mean
average.summary: Learn how to calculate and interpret the mean of data.
average.description: Learn how to calculate the average by leveling out multiple numerical values, and understand how to interpret it. The mean is widely used to represent the central tendency of test scores or experimental observations. Confident skills in multi-digit addition and division will help you solve problems accurately.

median-range.title: Median & range
median-range.summary: Learn how to find the median and range of a dataset.
median-range.description: Learn to find the median (the middle value or the mean of the two middle values for even data sizes) and the range (the difference between maximum and minimum). The median is a representative value resilient to extreme values. Prior knowledge of ordering numbers and calculating averages will aid your learning.

graphs.title: Tables & graphs
graphs.summary: Reading tables, bar and line graphs, pie charts and histograms.

tables.title: Tables & picture graphs
tables.summary: Organize data into tables and read simple pictographs.
tables.description: Learn how to count and organize surveyed items into structured tables and represent them using simple visual charts. This skill makes information clear at a glance when sharing observations with others. Being able to count items accurately and perform basic addition will ensure a solid foundation.

bar-graph.title: Bar graphs
bar-graph.summary: Read, draw, and interpret bar graphs with suitable scales.
bar-graph.description: Learn how to read and construct bar graphs, representing numerical quantities through the length of bars while choosing appropriate scale intervals. Bar graphs are essential for comparing quantities across different categories. Basic experience with data tables and the ability to interpret scale units will support your learning.

line-graph.title: Line graphs
line-graph.summary: Read and draw line graphs to show changes over time.
line-graph.description: Learn how to read and draw line graphs, which represent quantities changing over time, such as temperature or weight. Analyzing the slope of the lines helps identify increases and decreases. Prior familiarity with reading graph scales and plotting points connected by straight lines will facilitate your learning.

two-way-table.title: Two-way tables
two-way-table.summary: Organize data using two-way tables across two variables.
two-way-table.description: Learn how to organize data across two categories simultaneously using rows and columns in a two-way table. This format helps classify survey results, such as responses grouped by gender and preference. Familiarity with simple one-variable tables and accurate addition skills will ensure effective analysis.

pie-band.title: Pie & bar-percentage charts
pie-band.summary: Read and draw pie charts and divided bar graphs.
pie-band.description: Learn how to read and construct divided bar graphs and pie charts, representing parts of a whole as percentages totaling 100%. These charts are widely used in news reports and market research to visualize proportions. A solid grasp of calculating ratios and percentages beforehand will ensure success.

histogram.title: Histograms
histogram.summary: Learn to group data into intervals and create histograms.
histogram.description: Learn how to construct histograms by dividing continuous data into intervals and plotting frequencies as bar heights. Histograms are extensively used to evaluate data distribution, skewness, and spread. Reviewing frequency distribution tables and standard bar graphs beforehand will provide a smooth foundation.

counting.title: Arrangements & combinations
counting.summary: Counting arrangements and choices without missing or repeating any.

arrangements.title: Arrangements
arrangements.summary: Count permutations systematically using tree diagrams.
arrangements.description: Learn how to find all possible ordered arrangements (permutations) of items systematically using tree diagrams and lists. Counting outcomes without omission or duplication forms the foundation for probability theory. Cultivating organized habits in listing possibilities will help you solve these combinatorial problems with ease.

combinations.title: Combinations
combinations.summary: Find the number of combinations without regarding order.
combinations.description: Learn how to determine the total number of combinations when choosing items where the order of selection does not matter. This technique is practical for organizing tournaments, team selections, and everyday choices. Reviewing how to count permutations and structure organized tables will support your learning.

signed.title: Negative numbers
signed.summary: Arithmetic with negative numbers - practice keeping the signs right.

four-operations.title: Negative numbers
four-operations.description: Arithmetic with negative numbers - watch the signs.
four-operations.summary: Master the four arithmetic operations with signed numbers.

exponents.title: Powers & exponents
exponents.summary: Work with powers, the laws of exponents and scientific notation.

powers.title: Powers and exponent laws
powers.summary: Learn the meaning, notation, and calculation of powers.
powers.description: Learn the concept of powers representing repeated multiplication of the same number, their notation using exponents, and basic calculations. These skills form the foundation for working with algebraic expressions and equations. Confidence in performing multiplication with positive and negative numbers is helpful before beginning.

scientific.title: Scientific notation and significant figures
scientific.summary: Learn to express large numbers and use significant figures.
scientific.description: Learn how to express large numbers using powers of ten and handle significant figures, which represent meaningful digits in measurements. This approach is useful for reporting observational data and experimental measurements accurately. Prior knowledge of decimal place value and basic powers will support your understanding.

expression.title: Algebraic expressions
expression.summary: Practice substitution, combining like terms, and working with algebraic expressions.

value.title: Evaluating expressions
value.summary: Learn to evaluate expressions by substitution.
value.description: You will learn how to substitute specific numbers for variables to evaluate algebraic expressions. This skill is essential for calculating results from formulas in geometry and physics. Having a solid understanding of the four basic operations with positive and negative numbers is recommended before beginning.

like-terms.title: Combining like terms
like-terms.summary: Learn to simplify expressions by combining like terms.
like-terms.description: You will learn to identify terms with identical variable parts and combine them by adding or subtracting their coefficients. This fundamental skill is essential for simplifying complex expressions and solving algebraic equations. Prior knowledge of variables, coefficients, and operations with signed numbers will be helpful.

distribute.title: Distributive property
distribute.summary: Learn to expand expressions with the distributive property.
distribute.description: You will learn how to remove parentheses by multiplying each term inside by the outer value using the distributive property. This technique is widely used to simplify algebraic expressions and solve equations. Understanding basic multiplication rules and combining like terms will make this topic much easier to master.

polynomials.title: Monomials & polynomials
polynomials.summary: Learn operations on polynomials, monomials, and numbers.
polynomials.description: Learn how to add and subtract polynomials, multiply and divide monomials, and multiply or divide polynomials by numbers. Simplifying expressions by combining like terms forms the foundation for advanced algebraic calculations. Prior understanding of basic algebraic operations and the distributive property ensures smooth learning.

rearrange.title: Rearranging formulas
rearrange.summary: Learn how to rearrange formulas for a specific variable.
rearrange.description: You will learn how to rearrange equations to solve for a specific variable using algebraic properties. This skill is frequently applied to transform geometric formulas and scientific equations to isolate desired quantities. Prior understanding of solving basic linear equations and transposing terms is helpful for this topic.

linear-equation.title: Linear equations
linear-equation.summary: Practice solving linear equations, from moving terms to word problems.

basic.title: Moving terms across the equals sign
basic.summary: Learn to solve basic linear equations using transposition.
basic.description: You will understand the principle of transposing terms by reversing their signs across the equals sign to solve linear equations. This operation serves as the foundation for solving various mathematical problems involving unknowns. Prior knowledge of the basic properties of equality and signed numbers is helpful.

parentheses.title: Equations with parentheses
parentheses.summary: Learn to solve linear equations containing parentheses.
parentheses.description: You will learn the procedure for solving linear equations with parentheses by applying the distributive property before rearranging terms. This skill is useful when working with equations derived from real-world word problems. Prior mastery of the distributive property and basic transposition is recommended for smooth learning.

fraction.title: Equations with fractions
fraction.summary: Learn to solve linear equations containing fractions.
fraction.description: You will learn how to eliminate denominators by multiplying both sides by a common multiple to solve equations with integer coefficients. This approach is frequently used to handle equations arising from rates, ratios, and percentages. Familiarity with finding least common multiples and properties of equality is helpful.

proportion.title: Proportions (a : b = c : d)
proportion.summary: Learn to solve equations derived from proportions.
proportion.description: You will learn how to solve for an unknown in proportions using the property that the product of extremes equals the product of means. This skill is widely applied in calculating geometric scales, map ratios, and recipe mixtures. A solid understanding of basic ratios and linear equations is recommended beforehand.

word-problems.title: Word problems
word-problems.summary: Learn to model and solve real-world problems with equations.
word-problems.description: You will learn how to identify unknown quantities in word problems, set up linear equations, and verify the resulting solutions. This technique is applied to solve everyday problems involving costs, travel speeds, and quantities. Prior confidence in solving various linear equations is essential before tackling these problems.

simultaneous.title: Systems of equations
simultaneous.summary: Solve systems of equations using elimination and substitution.

elimination.title: Elimination
elimination.summary: Learn to solve simultaneous equations using elimination.
elimination.description: You will learn the elimination method to solve simultaneous equations by adding or subtracting equations to eliminate one variable. This technique provides a systematic way to solve problems involving multiple unknown quantities. Having a firm grasp of linear equations and arithmetic operations with polynomials is beneficial.

substitution.title: Substitution
substitution.summary: Learn to solve simultaneous equations using substitution.
substitution.description: You will learn how to solve simultaneous equations by isolating one variable in an equation and substituting it into the other. This method is particularly convenient when a variable is already expressed in terms of another. Prior knowledge of rearranging formulas and basic linear equations will support your learning.

word-problems.title: Word problems
word-problems.summary: Learn to model and solve word problems with systems.
word-problems.description: You will learn how to identify two unknowns, set up a system of linear equations from a problem, and interpret the solutions. This approach is widely applied to solve scenarios involving prices, travel times, or mixture quantities. Solid proficiency in elimination and substitution methods is required before starting.

linear-function.title: Proportionality & linear functions
linear-function.summary: Explore direct and inverse proportion, slopes, and intercepts.

proportion.title: Direct & inverse proportion
proportion.summary: Learn direct and inverse proportions and their graphs.
proportion.description: Learn direct proportion where the ratio between two quantities is constant, and inverse proportion where their product is constant, along with their graphs. These describe relationships like time and distance at constant speed, or rectangle dimensions with fixed area. Prior knowledge of coordinates and signed numbers helps your progress.

slope.title: Slope & intercept
slope.summary: Learn about slope and y-intercept in linear functions.
slope.description: You will explore how the slope and y-intercept determine the behavior and position of a straight line on a graph. This concept is widely used to visualize and model steady rates of increase or decrease in data. Prior knowledge of direct proportions and plotting coordinates will support your understanding.

two-points.title: Line through two points
two-points.summary: Find linear function equations from two given points.
two-points.description: Learn how to calculate the slope from two points with different coordinates to find the linear function whose graph is the line passing through them. This technique is useful for establishing linear models from observational data. Familiarity with slopes, intercepts, and systems of equations ensures smooth progress.

equations.title: Linear functions & equations
equations.summary: Learn the connection between linear equations and graphs.
equations.description: You will learn that two-variable linear equations represent straight lines, and the solution to a system corresponds to their intersection point. This topic bridges algebraic calculations with geometric visualizations to deepen mathematical reasoning. Prior mastery of graphing linear functions and solving simultaneous equations is recommended.

square-function.title: The function y = ax²
square-function.summary: Graphs of y = ax², rates of change, and where parabolas meet lines.

graph.title: Graphs & equations
graph.summary: Learn quadratic functions y=ax² and parabolic graphs.
graph.description: You will explore quadratic functions of the form y=ax², examining how the coefficient affects the opening and width of parabolas. These curves are widely used to model accelerating motion, such as freely falling objects. Prior knowledge of squaring numbers and plotting coordinates is helpful for understanding this topic.

rate-of-change.title: Rate of change
rate-of-change.summary: Learn the rate of change for quadratic functions y=ax².
rate-of-change.description: You will learn how to calculate the rate of change for y=ax² and understand why it varies across intervals, unlike linear functions. This concept is essential for determining average speeds in physics and serves as an introduction to calculus. Prior understanding of linear rates of change and function evaluation is recommended.

intersection.title: Parabolas & lines
intersection.summary: Learn to find intersection points of a parabola and a line.
intersection.description: Learn to find the coordinates of intersection points between a parabola and a line by solving a system of equations. This technique is frequently used to analyze geometric relationships between graphs. Before starting, it is helpful to have a solid understanding of linear functions and solving quadratic equations.

inequality.title: Inequalities
inequality.summary: Solve linear inequalities to find the range of values that satisfy them.

linear.title: Linear inequalities
linear.summary: Learn to solve linear inequalities and express solutions.
linear.description: Learn how to solve linear inequalities to determine the valid range of values, paying close attention to negative coefficients. This skill is widely applied when dealing with range conditions and constraints. Having a solid grasp of solving linear equations beforehand will make learning this topic much smoother.

quadratic.title: Quadratic inequalities
quadratic.summary: Learn to solve quadratic inequalities using graphs.
quadratic.description: Learn how to solve quadratic inequalities by analyzing the relationship between a quadratic graph and the x-axis. This method is essential for determining ranges and domains in various mathematical applications. Reviewing factoring techniques and how to sketch parabolas beforehand will help you understand the concepts more deeply.

absolute.title: Absolute value
absolute.summary: Solve equations and inequalities containing absolute values.
absolute.description: Learn how to solve equations and inequalities containing absolute values by considering different cases based on distance from the origin. This technique is widely used when evaluating error tolerances and intervals on a number line. Prior familiarity with linear equations, inequalities, and number lines will support your understanding.

expansion.title: Expanding expressions
expansion.summary: Use algebraic identities to expand expressions with parentheses.

formulas.title: Multiplication identities
formulas.summary: Learn to expand algebraic expressions using formulas.
formulas.description: Learn how to expand algebraic expressions efficiently using fundamental multiplication formulas such as the product of binomials. This foundation ensures speed and accuracy in calculations and is vital for subsequent factoring. Having a good grasp of the distributive property of polynomials beforehand is highly recommended.

square.title: Expanding squares
square.summary: Learn to expand squared binomials using formulas.
square.description: Learn to expand expressions in the form of squared binomials efficiently using the square of a sum and difference formulas. This skill is frequently required in completing the square and solving quadratic equations. Understanding basic polynomial expansion through the distributive property beforehand will make this topic easier.

sum-difference.title: Product of a sum and a difference
sum-difference.summary: Learn to expand the product of a sum and difference.
sum-difference.description: Learn the formula for expanding the product of the sum and difference of two terms into a difference of squares. This formula simplifies algebraic manipulation and is crucial for rationalizing denominators later on. Being comfortable with operations on positive and negative numbers and basic polynomial multiplication is beneficial.

three-terms.title: Expanding with three terms
three-terms.summary: Learn how to expand expressions containing three terms.
three-terms.description: Learn how to expand expressions containing three terms, such as the square of a trinomial, by grouping terms effectively. This technique is useful when simplifying complex symmetric algebraic expressions. Ensuring you are already familiar with two-term multiplication formulas will make this topic much easier to understand.

cubic.title: Cubic expansions
cubic.summary: Learn to expand cubic polynomials using formulas.
cubic.description: Learn how to expand cubic expressions efficiently using algebraic formulas such as the cube of a binomial. This calculation is essential for handling higher-degree polynomials and equations. Having a solid understanding of quadratic expansion formulas and combining like terms will help you master this topic smoothly.

factorization.title: Factoring
factorization.summary: Factor x² + ax + b into the form (x + p)(x + q). Practice for factoring quadratics.

common-factor.title: Factoring out common factors
common-factor.description: Take out the factor common to every term, sometimes followed by a formula.
common-factor.summary: Learn to factor by taking out common factors.

trinomial.title: Factoring trinomials
trinomial.description: Learn how to factor quadratic trinomials of the form x^2+(a+b)x+ab into (x+a)(x+b) by finding pairs with matching sums and products. You will practice fundamental problems where constants a and b are integers. Prior familiarity with expanding binomial expressions will help you grasp this technique quickly.
trinomial.summary: Factor quadratic trinomials into products of two binomials.

perfect-square.title: Perfect square trinomials
perfect-square.summary: Learn to factor perfect square trinomials into squares.

difference-of-squares.title: Difference of squares
difference-of-squares.description: Only the x² − a² form - good for learning to spot the pattern.
difference-of-squares.summary: Learn to factor a difference of squares into binomials.

factoring.title: Factoring (high school)
factoring.summary: High-school factoring: the ac method, two variables, substitution, sums and differences of cubes.

ac-method.title: The ac (cross) method
ac-method.description: Learn how to factor quadratic trinomials where the leading coefficient is not one by using cross-multiplication or the ac-method. This skill is helpful for factoring higher-degree polynomials and solving quadratic equations or inequalities. Prior mastery of basic factoring patterns and expansion formulas ensures smooth progress.

two-variables.title: Factoring with two variables
two-variables.summary: Learn to factor multi-variable expressions systematically.
two-variables.description: Learn how to factor expressions with two variables systematically by arranging terms in descending powers of the lower-degree variable. This strategy is essential for working with multivariable equations and symmetric expressions. Being proficient in single-variable factoring and extracting common factors beforehand is strongly recommended.

substitution.title: Substitution & biquadratics
substitution.summary: Learn to factor expressions using substitution methods.
substitution.description: Learn how to factor complex higher-degree polynomials and biquadratic expressions by substituting repeated parts with a single variable or forming a difference of squares. This technique is valuable for simplifying intricate algebraic expressions. Prior mastery of standard factoring formulas and quadratic equations is essential.

cubes.title: Sums & differences of cubes
cubes.summary: Factor cubic expressions using sum and difference of cubes.
cubes.description: Learn how to factor cubic expressions into linear and quadratic factors using the sum and difference of cubes formulas. This technique is widely utilized when solving higher-degree equations and simplifying algebraic fractions. Prior knowledge of cubic expansion formulas and quadratic factoring helps ensure smooth progress.

sqrt.title: Square roots
sqrt.summary: Practice calculating with square roots and rationalizing denominators.

rational-irrational.title: Rational & irrational numbers
rational-irrational.summary: Learn to distinguish rational and irrational numbers.
rational-irrational.description: Learn how to classify real numbers by understanding that rational numbers can be expressed as ratios of integers (with non-zero denominators), while irrational numbers cannot. This distinction helps clarify number systems and square root properties. Prior familiarity with fractions and decimals ensures smooth learning.

simplify.title: Simplifying radicals
simplify.summary: Learn to simplify radical expressions into standard form.
simplify.description: Learn how to simplify radical expressions by taking square factors out of the radical into their simplest radical form. This skill is indispensable for performing arithmetic with radicals and expressing solutions cleanly. Prior understanding of prime factorization and the definition of square roots will ensure a smooth learning experience.

add-sub.title: Adding & subtracting square roots
add-sub.summary: Learn to add and subtract radical expressions accurately.
add-sub.description: Learn how to add and subtract radical expressions by treating identical radicals like combined algebraic terms. This method is regularly used when calculating geometric lengths and simplifying solutions to quadratic equations. Reviewing how to simplify square roots and combine like terms beforehand is essential for quick mastery.

rationalize.title: Rationalizing denominators
rationalize.summary: Learn how to remove radicals from fraction denominators.
rationalize.description: You will learn how to eliminate radicals from the denominator of a fraction to simplify expressions. This technique makes calculating numerical values and comparing expressions much easier. A good understanding of square root properties and algebraic expansion is helpful before starting this topic.

double-radical.title: Nested radicals
double-radical.summary: Simplify nested radicals into sums or differences of roots.
double-radical.description: Learn how to transform nested radicals into the form of √a ± √b, expressing them as sums or differences of square roots. This technique simplifies expressions involving radicals and makes irrational values easier to handle. Prior mastery of algebraic expansions and basic square root arithmetic supports smooth learning.

prime.title: Prime factorization
prime.summary: Practice writing integers as products of prime numbers.

prime.title: Prime factorization
prime.summary: Factor integers greater than 1 into prime factors.
prime.description: Learn how to perform prime factorization by breaking down natural numbers greater than or equal to 2 into products of primes. This method is useful for examining properties of divisors and finding greatest common divisors. Prior knowledge of prime numbers and basic division will support your understanding.

integers.title: Number theory basics
integers.summary: The Euclidean algorithm, number bases and modular arithmetic.

euclid.title: Euclidean algorithm
euclid.summary: Learn the algorithm to find the greatest common divisor.
euclid.description: You will learn an efficient algorithm to find the greatest common divisor of two integers using division remainders. It is especially useful when dealing with large numbers that are hard to factor. Familiarity with the division algorithm and properties of integer remainders is helpful before learning this.

diophantine.title: Linear Diophantine equations
diophantine.summary: Learn how to solve linear Diophantine equations.
diophantine.description: You will learn how to find all integer solutions to equations with fewer equations than variables. This approach is widely used in discrete mathematics and problems requiring integer constraints. Mastering the Euclidean algorithm beforehand will make finding particular solutions much easier.

base-n.title: Number bases
base-n.summary: Learn positional numeral systems and radix conversion.
base-n.description: You will learn how to represent numbers using different bases, such as binary and hexadecimal, and how to convert between them. This is fundamental in computer science and digital data representation. Prior familiarity with place value in the base-ten system and integer division is recommended.

congruence.title: Modular arithmetic
congruence.summary: Learn arithmetic focusing on remainders of division.
congruence.description: You will learn how to perform modular arithmetic by grouping integers that share the same remainder when divided by a fixed number. It is useful for finding remainders of large powers and proving periodic properties. A basic understanding of integer division and remainders is recommended beforehand.

pythagoras.title: Pythagorean theorem
pythagoras.summary: Use the Pythagorean theorem to find side lengths in right triangles.

sides.title: Side lengths
sides.description: Find side lengths of right triangles using integers and square roots.
sides.summary: Find side lengths of right triangles using the theorem.

applications.title: Applying the Pythagorean theorem
applications.summary: Apply the Pythagorean theorem to coordinates and 3D shapes.
applications.description: Apply the Pythagorean theorem to find distances in coordinate planes and calculate lengths in three-dimensional shapes. This skill is widely used in advanced geometry, physics, and computer graphics. Prior experience in calculating side lengths of right triangles using the theorem is recommended.

probability.title: Probability
probability.summary: Learn probability basics by counting possible outcomes.

relative-frequency.title: Probability from many trials
relative-frequency.summary: How relative frequency approaches probability in trials.
relative-frequency.description: You will learn how the relative frequency of an event stabilizes around a constant value as an experiment is repeated many times. This forms the foundation for statistical estimation and modeling random phenomena. Prior familiarity with calculating ratios and interpreting frequency tables is beneficial.

basic.title: Probability basics
basic.summary: Learn how to find basic probabilities of random events.
basic.description: You will learn how to determine the probability of an event when all outcomes are equally likely. This concept is fundamental for analyzing uncertainty, predicting game odds, and making risk assessments. Being able to count outcomes systematically without omission or duplication beforehand is highly beneficial.

quadratic.title: Quadratic equations
quadratic.summary: Solve quadratic equations by factoring and using the quadratic formula.

factoring.title: Solving by factoring
factoring.summary: Learn how to solve quadratic equations by factoring.
factoring.description: You will learn how to solve quadratic equations by factoring expressions and setting each factor to zero. This technique is often used to solve geometric area problems and motion analysis efficiently. Mastering basic polynomial factoring formulas beforehand is essential for learning this method smoothly.

formula.title: Quadratic formula
formula.summary: Learn how to solve quadratic equations using the formula.
formula.description: Learn how to solve quadratic equations using the quadratic formula derived from completing the square. This formula enables students to reliably find solutions even when an equation cannot be easily factored. Prior understanding of square root properties and basic algebraic operations ensures smooth learning.

discriminant.title: Discriminant
discriminant.summary: Determine the number of real roots using the discriminant.
discriminant.description: You will learn how to determine the number of real roots without solving the equation by using the discriminant. It is widely used to analyze intersections between graphs and lines or to find parameter conditions in inequalities. Understanding the structure of the quadratic formula beforehand is helpful.

identities.title: Identities & the binomial theorem
identities.summary: Use the binomial theorem and polynomial identities.

binomial.title: Binomial theorem
binomial.summary: Learn the expansion of binomial powers and coefficients.
binomial.description: Learn the binomial theorem for expanding natural number powers of binomials and determining specific coefficients using combinations. This theorem is useful for extracting individual coefficients quickly and studying binomial distributions. Prior knowledge of algebraic expansion rules and combination calculations is recommended.

identity.title: Identities
identity.summary: Study identities true wherever both sides are defined.
identity.description: Learn the properties of identities that hold true for all values where both sides are defined, along with methods to determine unknown coefficients. Identities are fundamental for partial fraction decomposition and algebraic manipulation. Understanding polynomial expansion and the difference between equations and identities beforehand is beneficial.

inequality-proof.title: Proving inequalities
inequality-proof.summary: Learn methods for proving algebraic inequalities.
inequality-proof.description: You will learn fundamental methods to prove inequalities, such as taking differences, completing squares, and applying the AM-GM inequality. These techniques are vital for finding bounds of functions and establishing mathematical proofs. Prior proficiency in basic inequality properties and algebraic manipulation is recommended.

polynomial-equations.title: Polynomial equations
polynomial-equations.summary: Solve higher-degree equations with the remainder and factor theorems.

remainder.title: Remainder and factor theorems
remainder.summary: Learn to find polynomial remainders and linear factors.
remainder.description: You will learn the remainder theorem for finding polynomial remainders quickly, along with the factor theorem for identifying linear factors. These theorems are powerful tools for solving higher-degree equations and factoring polynomials. Familiarity with polynomial long division and evaluating algebraic expressions is recommended beforehand.

higher-degree.title: Higher-degree equations
higher-degree.summary: Learn how to solve equations of degree three or higher.
higher-degree.description: You will learn how to solve polynomial equations of degree three or higher using the factor theorem and special factoring techniques. These skills are used to find graph intersections and solve geometric volume problems. Prior mastery of the factor theorem and quadratic equations will help significantly.

quadratic-function.title: Quadratic functions
quadratic-function.summary: Find the vertex of a parabola and the maximum or minimum of a quadratic function.

vertex.title: Vertex

sets.1: Reading the vertex from a graph

vertex.summary: Learn how to find the vertex of a quadratic function.
vertex.description: You will learn how to determine the vertex and axis of symmetry of a parabola by completing the square. This is crucial for sketching graphs and finding the maximum or minimum values of quadratic functions. Prior knowledge of algebraic expansion and factoring is recommended for smooth learning.

max-min.title: Maximum & minimum
max-min.summary: Learn to find maximum and minimum values of quadratics.
max-min.description: You will learn how to find maximum and minimum values of quadratic functions, considering restricted domains and their positions relative to the axis of symmetry. This is widely used in real-world optimization problems such as maximizing area or profit. Prior mastery of completing the square and sketching parabolas is essential.

graph.title: Graphs and equations
graph.summary: Learn relations between quadratic graphs and equations.
graph.description: You will learn how to determine quadratic equations from geometric conditions and understand how parabolas shift on the coordinate plane. This knowledge is applied in trajectory analysis and modeling data. Prior familiarity with finding vertices and basic coordinate geometry is recommended.

sequence.title: Sequences
sequence.summary: Explore arithmetic and geometric sequences and calculate their sums.

arithmetic.title: Arithmetic sequences
arithmetic.summary: Learn general terms and sums of arithmetic sequences.
arithmetic.description: Learn how to find the general term and the sum of arithmetic sequences. This concept is widely used to analyze steady patterns and compute cumulative totals. Basic knowledge of linear algebraic expressions will help you better understand and apply the formulas.

geometric.title: Geometric sequences
geometric.summary: Learn general terms and sums of geometric sequences.
geometric.description: Learn how to find the general term and the sum of geometric sequences. These principles are frequently used to model compound interest, population growth, and other multiplicative processes. Familiarity with exponent rules and basic algebraic operations provides a strong foundation for this topic.

sigma.title: Sigma notation & sums
sigma.summary: Learn summation notation and calculation using sigma.
sigma.description: Learn the meaning of sigma notation and how to calculate various series using summation formulas. This notation is essential for expressing complicated sums concisely and preparing for calculus and limits. Prior understanding of arithmetic and geometric series will help you grasp these techniques smoothly.

recurrence.title: Recurrence relations
recurrence.summary: Learn to find general terms from recurrence relations.
recurrence.description: Learn methods for determining the general term of a sequence from recurrence relations connecting consecutive terms. This mathematical approach is vital for modeling discrete dynamic processes and analyzing algorithms. Familiarity with basic sequences, summation formulas, and equation-solving techniques will assist your progress.

induction.title: Mathematical induction
induction.summary: Learn to prove propositions using mathematical induction.
induction.description: Learn how to use mathematical induction, a powerful proof technique for statements involving natural numbers. It is widely used to verify summation formulas, divisibility properties, and sequence behaviors. A solid grasp of algebraic manipulation and basic logical deduction will prepare you well for this concept.

trig.title: Trigonometric ratios & functions
trig.summary: Practice special-angle values, radians, and angle addition formulas.

values.title: Values of trigonometric functions
values.summary: Evaluate trigonometric functions using the unit circle.
values.description: Learn how to evaluate sine, cosine, and tangent for general angles using the unit circle. These values are fundamental for describing circular motions, periodic phenomena, and wave behaviors. Prior familiarity with right-triangle trigonometry and angle definitions provides an excellent basis for mastering this topic.

radian.title: Radians
radian.summary: Learn radian measure as arc length divided by radius.
radian.description: Learn how angles are measured in radians by dividing arc length by the radius, and convert between radians and degrees. Radians simplify mathematical calculations and are essential for calculus and physics modeling. Prior knowledge of circumference and sector formulas will help you transition smoothly to this topic.

addition.title: Angle addition formulas
addition.summary: Learn addition formulas for sums and differences of angles.
addition.description: Learn addition and subtraction formulas to compute trigonometric values of the sum and difference of two angles. These formulas are fundamental for simplifying trigonometric expressions and analyzing wave patterns. Prior familiarity with coordinates on the unit circle will assist in understanding their derivations and applications.

double-angle.title: Double- & half-angle formulas
double-angle.summary: Learn double-angle and half-angle trigonometric formulas.
double-angle.description: Learn how to derive and apply double-angle and half-angle formulas from addition theorems. These formulas are vital when solving trigonometric equations and reducing powers in calculus calculations. A firm understanding of fundamental addition formulas will allow you to work through these problems with confidence.

synthesis.title: Combining sine & cosine
synthesis.summary: Learn to combine sine and cosine into a single sine wave.
synthesis.description: Learn how to combine linear expressions of sine and cosine into a single sinusoidal function. This technique is widely used to find extreme values and analyze combined simple harmonic oscillations. Having a solid understanding of addition formulas and unit circle representations will make mastering this method straightforward.

graph.title: Graphs of trigonometric functions
graph.summary: Graph trig functions with period and sine/cosine amplitude.
graph.description: Learn how to sketch graphs of sine, cosine, and tangent functions, focusing on period, phase shifts, and the amplitude of sine and cosine. Visualizing these graphs is essential for interpreting periodic phenomena such as sound waves and alternating currents. Prior familiarity with radian angles and standard values will facilitate your sketching skills.

exp-log.title: Exponents & logarithms
exp-log.summary: Practice exponent rules and basic logarithm calculations.

exponent.title: Exponent rules
exponent.summary: Learn laws of exponents extended to rational numbers.
exponent.description: Learn how exponent rules extend from positive integers to negative numbers, fractions, and real exponents. These computational rules are fundamental for modeling rapid expansion, exponential decay, and scientific notation in science and engineering. Prior comfort with basic integer powers and polynomial operations will help you master these fractional exponents.

log.title: Calculating logarithms
log.summary: Learn logarithmic properties and base change calculations.
log.description: Learn the formal definition of logarithms as the inverse of exponentiation, along with operational rules and the change-of-base formula. Logarithms are widely used to handle wide-ranging scales such as sound intensity, acidity, and data entropy. Prior proficiency with exponent properties is essential for understanding logarithmic transformations.

common-log.title: Common logarithms
common-log.summary: Learn common logarithms and find digits of large numbers.
common-log.description: Learn how to use base-10 common logarithms to determine the number of digits and orders of magnitude for large powers. This application is crucial in scientific fields for estimating extremely large or small quantities like atomic particles or astronomical distances. Solid knowledge of basic logarithmic identities will ensure an easy transition to these calculations.

conic.title: Conic sections
conic.summary: Parabolas, ellipses and hyperbolas, with parametric and polar forms.

parabola.title: Parabolas
parabola.summary: Learn the geometric definition and equations of parabolas.
parabola.description: Learn the geometric definition of a parabola based on a focus and directrix, along with its standard Cartesian equation. Parabolas are widely utilized in engineering for designing reflective antennas and analyzing ballistic trajectories. Prior familiarity with quadratic functions and the coordinate distance formula will provide useful background knowledge.

ellipse-hyperbola.title: Ellipses and hyperbolas
ellipse-hyperbola.summary: Learn ellipses, hyperbolas, and hyperbolic asymptotes.
ellipse-hyperbola.description: Learn definitions and standard equations for ellipses (constant sum of focal distances) and hyperbolas (constant absolute difference of focal distances), along with hyperbolic asymptotes. These curves are essential for describing celestial orbits and navigation systems. Prior knowledge of circle equations and geometric loci will help you understand these curves.

polar.title: Parametric and polar forms
polar.summary: Learn parametric curves and polar coordinate equations.
polar.description: Learn how to represent curves using parametric equations and describe coordinates using distances and angles in polar coordinate systems. These representations are particularly useful for analyzing complicated trajectories and rotationally symmetric physical systems. Prior proficiency with trigonometry, angle measurement, and vector operations will facilitate your understanding of these representations.

combinatorics.title: Counting & probability
combinatorics.summary: Use permutations and combinations to count outcomes and calculate probabilities.

permutations.title: Permutations
permutations.summary: Learn permutation formulas to count ordered arrangements.
permutations.description: Learn how to calculate permutations to find the number of ways to arrange items in a specific order. This mathematical technique is widely used in problems involving passcode combinations, scheduling order, and ranking possibilities. Prior knowledge of the multiplication principle and tree diagrams will help you master these permutation formulas.

combinations.title: Combinations
combinations.summary: Learn combination formulas to count unordered selections.
combinations.description: Learn how to use combination formulas to determine the number of ways to choose items when order does not matter. Combinations are essential for team selections, lottery odds, and binomial expansion coefficients. Familiarity with permutations and factorial calculations provides an important foundation for working with these selection techniques.

probability.title: Probability
probability.summary: Learn basic probability and calculate event likelihoods.
probability.description: Learn the fundamental rules of probability to quantify how likely an event is to occur among all equally likely outcomes. Probability is indispensable for risk assessment, statistical decision-making, and analyzing games of chance. Mastering prior counting techniques like permutations and combinations will prepare you well for calculating probabilities accurately.

independent.title: Independent & repeated trials
independent.summary: Calculate probabilities of independent and repeated trials.
independent.description: This topic covers calculating probabilities for independent events and repeated trials under the same conditions. These principles are widely used to analyze repetitive processes, such as games and quality control. Prior knowledge of fundamental probability concepts and combinations is essential for this topic.

conditional.title: Conditional probability
conditional.summary: Learn to calculate the probability of conditional events.
conditional.description: This topic covers calculating conditional probabilities, which determine the likelihood of an event occurring given that another event has already happened. It is widely used in medical testing and predictive models to update probabilities with new evidence. A solid understanding of basic probability and set operations is recommended.

expectation.title: Expected value
expectation.summary: Learn to calculate the expected value of random outcomes.
expectation.description: This topic covers calculating the expected value by summing products of numerical outcomes and their probabilities. It is extensively applied in risk assessment, lottery evaluations, and insurance pricing to support decision-making. Students should be familiar with calculating basic probabilities and adding values before studying this concept.

distributions.title: Probability distributions
distributions.summary: Expected values, variances and probabilities of binomial and normal distributions.

random-variables.title: Random variables, mean & variance
random-variables.summary: Learn expected value and variance of random variables.
random-variables.description: This topic explores random variables whose values are determined by trial outcomes, calculating their expected value and variance. These measures are crucial for quantifying uncertainty and analyzing statistical risks in science and finance. Prior familiarity with foundational probability concepts and basic summation is recommended for this study.

binomial.title: Binomial distribution
binomial.summary: Learn binomial distributions for fixed-probability trials.
